title: Display all Lead records from backend collection

requirements.text: Create a new page or section that displays all records from the Leads collection in a user-friendly table format showing full name, email, country, target job role, and submission timestamp

quotes: Show me all records currently stored in the Leads collection.

acceptanceCriteria: All lead records are fetched from the backend using the existing getAllLeads query
Records are displayed in a table with columns for all Lead fields (full name, email, country, target job role, timestamp)
Timestamps are formatted in a human-readable format
Loading and error states are handled appropriately
Empty state is shown when no records exist

constraints: Use the existing useAllLeads hook from frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts
Follow the existing AdminPage.tsx pattern for displaying leads
Do not modify backend/main.mo as getAllLeads functionality already exists
nonGoals: Adding authentication requirements for viewing leads
